title: Harvey for Innovation Teams: Lead Firmwide AI Transformation
format_note: Music-only tour of Harvey's admin and builder features: five chapter title cards, each followed by a cursor-driven UI scene on a Whitford Lane demo workspace.
one_thing: Firms that have built legal knowledge can run firmwide AI transformation in Harvey: build workflows, deploy playbooks, curate knowledge, control access and track usage.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. Local whisper returned only the repeated word 'The' at 0, 30 and 60 s, so it was discarded.
transcript.script_shape: Hook line 'You've built the knowledge.', 'Now' pivot, four example tasks, then five chapter titles over UI scenes, and a closing line 'Lead your firm's transformation.'

structure.frame0: Harvey wordmark, white serif, centred on near-black (mean luminance 0.059, contentfulCells 0.05). A lone logo, not a subject poster.
structure.first_3s: Wordmark holds to 1.46 s, hard cut to white, 'You've built the knowledge.' fades in word by word (1.46-1.84 s) and holds to the 3.42 s cut.

beats.what: Black knowledge graph: labelled nodes (Whitford Lane, Recent Ruling, Legal Precedent) multiply and link; 'Now' flashes on white at 6.96 s.
Graph lights a path per task: Draft a Client Alert, Summarize Interview Calls, Conduct Post-Merger Compliance Review, Build Case Strategy for Litigation.
Cut to light ground: 'Design Your Workspace', then the H app tile at 18 s.
Workflow builder: sidebar and canvas, typed File upload card, Text Input branch to Yes/No paths, access modal.
'Manage Templates Across Teams': lease-terms table, column labels, Vault Workflows template card.
'Deploy Your Playbooks': playbook upload by drag, Review buttons, NDA playbook PDF, Fallback positions form with typed Guidance.
'Curate Firm Knowledge': Create knowledge base form, folder drag, Fraud Cases file list, Vault grid.
'Control Access and Usage': Roles permission grid, Assistant Workflows checkbox, Users table, role dropdown.
'Track Usage and Adoption': Analytics pie and area charts (904 unique users), most-recent-query table.
Harvey wordmark on near-black, fades out by about 106 s; last 2.9 s black and silent.

good.observation: The hook says the whole film in four words, on a clean white card with nothing competing, and the pivot 'Now' answers it.

A repeatable chapter pattern: a 3-4 word title on empty ground, then one UI scene that proves it. Six verbs (Design, Manage, Deploy, Curate, Control, Track) make the feature list scannable without speech.
Real-looking product UI with plausible data (Whitford Lane, case names, 904 unique users) and a visible cursor makes the claims concrete.
Camera crops to one card or control, so a dense interface reads one thing at a time; the viewer sees the whole window first, then the detail.
Black graph opening and black wordmark ending bookend the film around a long light middle, so the brand mark opens and closes the film.
Restraint: one typeface per role, no accent colour on type, one idea per frame; titles hold still once built.

weak.observation: Full-window UI frames put text about 7-9 px tall at 720p, unreadable at phone width until the camera zooms.
The film opens on a lone wordmark for 1.46 s, and ends with no URL, button or next step on screen.
The closing line 'Lead your firm's transformation.' sits on a grey card of unknown length (on screen at 98 s, cut at 98.97 s), a payoff with no visual weight beyond type.
A static share of 0.296 of sampled intervals and an 8 s run ending at 52 s leave long near-identical stretches in the middle of the film.

rule_candidates.rule: When the film has no voice, open on the claim: put a 4-word first line on screen within 1.5 s, and let a brand mark wait until the end.
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 1: frame 0 is a poster with the subject in it

rule_candidates.rule: A feature tour may run one 40+ s continuous shot if the camera moves, a UI state changes or a title turns over roughly every 2-3 s; count internal changes, not cuts.
rule_candidates.evidence: Longest shot 43.96 s, 40.3% of runtime; 7 cuts at 3.85 per minute
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 10: cuts every 1.8-3.5 s in launch films

rule_candidates.rule: Structure a multi-feature tour as repeating pairs: a 3-4 word verb-led title on a blank ground, then one 8-12 s UI scene for that feature.
rule_candidates.evidence: Five titles at 38, 50, 64, 76, 88 s each followed by one scene

rule_candidates.rule: Show the whole app window for about 2 s so the viewer knows where they are, then crop to a single card or control at 2x or more before asking them to read.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0012 whole window, f0014-f0015 and f0042 cropped
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 5: every must-carry fact legible at phone width

rule_candidates.rule: Build titles word by word, about 0.1 s a word for a 4-word line, with later words greyer until the line lands, then hold the title perfectly still.
rule_candidates.evidence: window-01-1.377s.jpg 0.38 s for four words; window-07-10.052s.jpg
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 4: a landed title holds dead still

rule_candidates.rule: Animate interface use with a real arrow cursor, typed text and drag ghosts (folder, PDF with green plus) rather than describing the action in a caption.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0014-f0015 typed 'patent application'; f0036 folder drag; f0027 PDF drag
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 10: real product UI beats invented UI

rule_candidates.rule: Master a music-only film near -14 LUFS with true peak under -1 dBTP; leave music unsynced to cuts if section changes still land on the main cut.
rule_candidates.evidence: -13.9 LUFS, -4.5 dBTP; cut share 0.143 vs chance 0.088
rule_candidates.skill_rule: Rule 9: social masters at -14 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP

rule_candidates.rule: Close with the brand wordmark on the opening's dark ground, hold about 5 s and fade to 2-3 s of silence; give the last line at least 2 s first.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0051-f0055; silence span 106.1-109.0 s; closing line gone at 98.97 s
